author: storemapper

sections.installation:
Follow these step-by-step instructions to install and configure the Storemapper plugin on your WordPress website.

Install the Storemapper Plugin
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to the left-hand menu and click on Plugins.
2. In the search bar, type Storemapper and find the plugin.
3. Click Install to add it to your website.

Activate the Storemapper Plugin
4. Still in the Plugins section of the WordPress menu, find and click on Installed Plugins.
5. Locate Storemapper in the list of installed plugins.
6. Click Activate to enable it on your site.

Retrieve Your Storemapper Account Data
7. Create your Storemapper account here.
8. Open your Storemapper dashboard in a new tab.
9. Go to Installation (or Settings >).
10. Under Instructions for popular platforms, select WordPress.
11. Copy the Account Data provided in this section.

Connect Storemapper to Your WordPress Site
12. After activating the plugin, a new option called “Storemapper” will appear in the WordPress left-hand menu.
13. Click on Storemapper.
14. Paste the Account Data you copied from Storemapper into the appropriate field.
15. Click Save to complete the setup.

Add the Store Locator to a Page
16. In your WordPress menu, go to Pages.
17. Select an existing page where you want to add the store locator or create a new one.
18. In the WordPress editor, click on Add Block.
19. Search for and select the Storemapper block.
20. Save or publish the page to make your store locator visible on your website.

✅ Done! Your Storemapper store locator is now installed and ready to use on your WordPress website.
sections.description:
The Store Locator App: Easy to install, fully customizable and proven to drive more traffic

Storemapper: Store Locator Map & Widget

StoreMapper: the powerful Store Locator map designed to seamlessly integrate with your WordPress site. Customers can effortlessly find nearby stores, ensuring they always know where to find you or your products.

Our analytics show which locations get the most search and traffic, helping you make better marketing decisions. Features include Google reviews, business hours, and support for multiple users.

Elevate customer experience, enhance visibility and drive traffic to your stores!

Requirements:

The plugin requires a Storemapper account. Sign up for a trial at http://storemapper.com.

Features:
* Auto-sync store locations from Google Drive, Shopify account & Google Business Profile more.
* Insightful data on customers’ product search and addresses they are looking for.
* Embed Google Maps with custom pins; use Google’s powerful & accurate geocoder.
* We’re also a product locator, lead collection and store information management.
* Show customer feedback and business hours directly from your Google API.

Demo store: https://www.storemapper.com/demo/

Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/embed/ZLwDgreyZ5U

Privacy Policy URL: https://www.storemapper.com/privacy/

FAQ: https://help.storemapper.com/

Meta description: An easy to use store locator map software to help customers find your stores. Install in minutes – no coding. Fully customizable.
